value.rationale: The motivating paper establishes polarization contraction only with homogeneous peer susceptibility on regular networks and illustrates irregular cases numerically. The new theorem specifies the exact conserved and contracting statistic for arbitrarily heterogeneous reciprocal networks, gives sharp quantitative rates, and rigorously shows why ordinary equal-weight variance can increase at the minimal population size. This distinguishes a physically motivated network weighting from an invalid generalization of a standard global statistic; it is more than an arbitrary computed slice.
